QuestInfo.name: [Ren] To Saya's Side
QuestInfo.0: Someone might know about Saya. You need to make sure she's safe right away.
QuestInfo.1: Someone might know about Saya. You need to make sure she's safe right away.
QuestInfo.2: Fortunately, Saya was safe. She speculated that it was just a curious scholar, but you still felt uneasy. Saya gave you one of her scales and said to hand it in while mentioning that you found it far away.
